name: MD-P300
tagline: Flip chip, thermosonic and thermocompression bonding in one compact machine

intro.text: The Panasonic MD-P300 is a process-flexible flip chip bonder. Changing the bonding tool switches it between thermosonic, C4 and thermocompression (TCB) processes. It takes 12-inch (300 mm) wafers and suits chip-on-board hybrid assembly next to Panasonic SMT placement machines.

items: 0.65 s per IC for C4 (including dipping) and thermosonic bonding
Bonding process selected by changing tools
Suited to processors, CMOS sensors, MEMS and power devices
Real-time inspection, with an optional bonding-stage camera to inspect right after die bonding

rows:
C4: 0.65 s/IC (including dipping)
Thermosonic: 0.65 s/IC (including 0.2 s ultrasonic time)
L 1 × W 1 to L 25 × W 25 mm (thermosonic: up to L 7 × W 7 mm)
Up to 12 types (AWC specification), 1 nozzle type
L 50 × W 50 to L 330 × W 330 mm (heated stage: L 330 × W 220 mm)
VCM head: 1 to 50 N (option: 2 to 100 N)
3-phase AC 200 V ±10 V, 50/60 Hz, up to 4 kVA (7 kVA with heating)
0.4 MPa, 50 L/min (up to 150 L/min fully equipped)

blocks.text: Standard specifications from Panasonic. Productivity and accuracy depend on usage conditions.
